page.layout: Single printed page. Running head at top: page number "342" left and "TEMPLA DICATA" centred. Below, two headings: "H. ab Ethnicis." left and "a Papistis." right. Then three columns of names: left column (Ethnic gods), a narrow middle column of Christian saints with a vertical bracket and rotated side label, and a right column of saints. Below: a section heading "I. Sic ARAE & ALTARIA, dicata." followed by two columns: left column of dedications with italic names, right column of saints' names. Then a sub-heading "BACCHI ara, in Rheno." with lines below, and at the foot a catchword-like "Idola" at lower right.
page.notes: The text is set in two columns with a narrow centre column of saints' names and a rotated side label ("Inhibit. ... ACA") between the bracketed lists; the layout is reproduced line by line in order of the columns. The word "Idola" at the foot is a catchword/signature-like mark; left as printed. Several words are uncertain due to damage and faint print, notably in the centre column and at the bottom right.
